category.title: ActionScript 2
category.description: Tracked families of language features and Flash APIs. The completed share of this registry is not a percentage of Flash Player compatibility.

features.title: Source diagnostics
features.scope: Parse errors and unsupported frontend constructs report the language, line and column; compilation errors block export.
features.limitations: This guarantees compiler diagnostics, not verification of every Flash API semantic.

features.title: Literals
features.scope: Decimal, hexadecimal and exponent numbers; strings; Boolean, null, undefined, NaN and Infinity; arrays without holes and object literals.
features.limitations: The full set of literals and historical Flash rules is not implemented; legacy numbers with leading zeroes are rejected.

features.title: Variables and scope
features.scope: var, multiple declarations, handler-owner fields, and hoisting of local var declarations and parameters.
features.limitations: Handler fields differ from classes and the full Flash scope chain; top-level declarations follow documented reinitialization rules.

features.title: Arithmetic, logic and assignments
features.scope: Basic arithmetic, comparisons, short-circuit evaluation, bitwise operations, ++/-- and compound assignments.
features.limitations: Some operations use JavaScript coercion; this is not complete AVM semantics across all Flash Player versions.

features.title: If/else branches
features.scope: Parsing and execution of if/else, blocks and the conditional expression ?:, selecting one branch.
features.limitations: This covers control flow in the supported frontend; conversion of arbitrary Flash objects remains part of unfinished type compatibility.

features.title: Classic loops and jumps
features.scope: while, do/while, three-part for, and nested break/continue with jump-target validation.
features.limitations: for..in property enumeration and full compatibility of condition coercion are tracked separately.

features.title: Switch and fallthrough
features.scope: Single evaluation of the subject, sequential case matching, default, fallthrough and break.
features.limitations: The supported contract uses strict comparison; compatibility across Flash Player versions is not certified.

features.title: Function declarations and calls
features.scope: Function declarations and expressions, recursion, mutual recursion, return, callbacks and immediately invoked function expressions. Bounded runtime lookup of user-defined timeline callbacks and capture of the timeline where the function was defined.
features.limitations: Declarations must be directly inside a function or handler body; there is no general project resolver. Missing or non-callable functions and unsupported native goto aliases produce diagnostics; complete AVM1 lookup and ordering are not reproduced.

features.title: Closures and variable capture
features.scope: Lexical local variables, shadowing, closures retained after return, and capture of the handler owner.
features.limitations: The complete Flash receiver, global-object and scope-chain models are not implemented.

features.title: Function parameters and returns
features.scope: Positional parameters; AS2 annotations are erased; missing and extra arguments follow JavaScript behavior.
features.limitations: Default/rest parameters, arguments and general Function.call/apply are absent; full compatibility of types and invocation errors is unproven.

features.title: this and method binding
features.scope: this refers to the frame/object handler owner; recognized onEnterFrame/onPress callback functions use the active callback receiver. Lexical owner fields remain available inside other functions.
features.limitations: General explicit this in other AS2 functions and nested/expression functions remains rejected where receiver/global semantics are not implemented.

features.title: Annotations and type system
features.scope: Selected Number/String/Boolean/Function/Error annotations and return-only Void are accepted; annotations are erased.
features.limitations: There is no complete type checker, user-defined class model or typed instance-slot model; this.field writes and writes from another handler do not enforce the declared type.

features.title: Throw, catch and finally
features.scope: Explicit throw preserving the payload, untyped catch and catch(Error), finally and rethrow.
features.limitations: AS2 catch does not intercept native JavaScript/host errors; catch bindings and variable capture have restrictions.

features.title: Error objects
features.scope: A limited new Error facade, message and toString.
features.limitations: General class construction, getStackTrace, complete prototype semantics and all Flash error codes are absent.

features.title: Classes, inheritance and interfaces
features.scope: A complete model of class/interface, extends/implements, members, super, getters/setters and general new.
features.limitations: AS2 class/prototype source units remain unsupported. The new AS3 project program does not implement the separate AS2 class model.

features.title: Imports and project linking
features.scope: import, external AS2 classes, symbol linkage and cross-file resolution.
features.limitations: AS2 continues to compile synchronous frame/object handlers. Project sources/linkage currently require the separate AS3 class profile; AS2 external class resolution is not implemented.

features.title: Dynamic objects and prototypes
features.scope: Object literals, custom fields, property/index reads and explicitly defined function members.
features.limitations: There is no complete Object/prototype/scope-chain model; computed calls, general alias/type inference and some dynamic methods are rejected.

features.title: Property enumeration and with
features.scope: for..in enumeration and correct name lookup inside with.
features.limitations: These are unsupported; a classic three-part for loop does not implement property enumeration.

features.title: Additional language operators
features.scope: instanceof, in, delete, unary void and general new.
features.limitations: These are rejected with diagnostics; the separate new Error facade does not complete this capability.

features.title: Primitives and global conversions
features.scope: Number, Boolean, parseFloat, isNaN and isFinite retain JavaScript-backed conversions. String now uses the bounded primitive family facade; parseInt retains its separate pinned AS2 profile and earlier HTML5 acceptance.
features.limitations: Complete historical coercions, boxed values and the full standard library remain unfinished. New Array/String expectations are documented_only; browser acceptance of that increment is pending.

features.title: Math
features.scope: A closed list of numeric Math methods, including trigonometry, abs, min/max, pow, random and round.
features.limitations: Execution is delegated to JavaScript; the full contract and numerical equivalence with Flash are not certified.

features.title: Array, String and Number methods
features.scope: Bounded Array constructors and mutation/slicing, comparator/flag sort and multi-field sortOn; primitive String conversion, UTF-16 access/search/slicing/splitting/concatenation/casing. Shared adapters preserve custom overrides and lookup order in handlers and project methods. AS2 Number formatting and the Array search extension remain JavaScript-backed rather than complete native AS2 contracts.
features.limitations: Partial profiles: 1,000,000 array entries/string code units or results; ordinary records, restricted sortOn options, no native method extraction/prototype augmentation, RegExp/custom string patterns, locale operations or complete historical coercion/order. AS3 NUMERIC requires numeric values; AS2 boxed String is unsupported. See fixture profile constants for exact dialect limits. Browser acceptance of this increment is pending.

features.title: Trace through the browser host
features.scope: trace from handlers and nested functions runs through the host, updating the console and player status line.
features.limitations: This implements the observable NeoFlash output channel; complete formatting of all Flash types is not claimed.

features.title: MovieClip and timelines
features.scope: play/stop, gotoAndPlay/gotoAndStop and nextFrame/prevFrame return undefined; current/total frames, named children and independent nested clocks remain available. AS2 labels use ASCII folding, first duplicate match and missing-label no-op; bounded numeric strings take precedence.
features.limitations: This is a limited MovieClip facade; complete construction/re-entry, scenes, dynamic display lists and the Flash lifecycle are not implemented. Native goto aliases and complete historical numeric and lookup rules are unsupported.

features.title: Display properties
features.scope: Position, scale, alpha, bounded finite rotation readback, visibility, root/parent and AS2 aliases including _name/_width/_height. The shared facade supplies name lookup, transformed bounds/coordinates and supported nonrotated dimension changes.
features.limitations: Full MovieClip APIs, dynamic placements, masks/filters and TextField/Button contracts remain incomplete. Rotated dimension writes and noninvertible coordinate conversions diagnose; legacy rotation/visibility coercion is not full AVM1 conformance. Representative family behavior passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; this is not full API or cross-engine acceptance.

features.title: Events and handlers
features.scope: Authored frame and load/click/enter_frame handlers plus recognized onEnterFrame/onPress callback assignment/removal on compatible authored instances, with receiver/lifetime checks and bounded dispatch.
features.limitations: Other native callback properties, AS2 global Stage/Key/Mouse listener APIs, source on/onClipEvent wrappers and exact Flash lifecycle ordering remain pending. The AS3 EventDispatcher bridge is not an AS2 class implementation.

features.title: Programmatic drawing
features.scope: MovieClip drawing APIs, bitmap fills and programmatic Flash graphics.
features.limitations: Authored vector shapes and their Canvas rendering do not provide a Graphics API callable from ActionScript.

features.title: TextField and text APIs
features.scope: Existing authored Text elements now have live text/textColor, UTF-16 length, append/replace, line queries and partial Canvas text metrics through the shared runtime. Overrides leave authored content unchanged and clear with placement removal/replacement or Restart.
features.limitations: Plain string values and RGB integers only; 1 MiB UTF-8 text and bounded UTF-16 replacement ranges preserving complete characters. No rich formatting/HTML, wrapping, input/selection, embedded fonts or dynamic TextField creation. Canvas width and 1.2×font-size line height are not full Flash layout. Shared helpers do not establish every historical AS2 method. Browser acceptance of this increment is pending.

features.title: Audio, video and resource loading
features.scope: Flash media APIs, loading of images, audio and video, playback control and synchronization.
features.limitations: The authoring/runtime model does not yet provide the corresponding ActionScript APIs.

features.title: Networking, storage and external communication
features.scope: Flash networking/loaders, SharedObject and explicitly defined browser bridges.
features.limitations: JavaScript access to the browser does not imply support for equivalent ActionScript APIs.

features.title: Components and platform libraries
features.scope: AS2 UI/component libraries and related Flash platform APIs.
features.limitations: These libraries are not implemented; porting platform APIs requires an explicit supported/adapted/unavailable contract.

features.title: Complete virtual-machine semantics
features.scope: AVM1 compatibility, including Flash Player versions, coercion, scope chains and runtime errors.
features.limitations: The current frontend emits JavaScript; internal regression tests are not Flash Player conformance certification.

features.title: Debugger and source maps
features.scope: ActionScript debugging with original source lines, breakpoints and state inspection.
features.limitations: Compile/publish diagnostics exist; a complete source debugger is absent.

features.title: Source on / onClipEvent wrappers
features.scope: Parsing legacy object-script wrappers and compatible AS2 event registration.
features.limitations: The editor event selector accepts only a handler body; source wrappers are unsupported.

features.title: XML
features.scope: AS2 XML/XMLNode and their parsing, traversal and networking contracts.
features.limitations: The XML API is absent; XML parsing in the XFL importer does not execute AS2 XML.
